description: Projectile motion under gravity, graph-native. CENTRAL IDEA: a Launcher holds launch state (position x0,y0; muzzle speed v; gravity g); a Target holds where to hit (tx,ty, read RELATIVE as x=tx-x0,y=ty-y0). The INVERSE of the trajectory = THE FIRING SOLUTION: th = Atan2(v^2 +/- sqrt(D), g x) with D = v^4 - g(g x^2 + 2 y v^2). D>=0 <=> reachable; '-' = low/direct arc, '+' = high/lob arc; D<0 => out of range, no angle. Forward concepts (impact_y_low/high, hits_low/high) self-check by substituting th back. COMPOSES with projection: a Target's (tx,ty) can be the world (X,Y) a triangulated Feature recovers. Pure Sin/Cos/Atan2/Sqrt/Plus/Minus/Times/Div/Abs/Gte/Lt - no Rust, no new primitive. | v1.2.0 BOUNCING: reflect_vx/vy=v-(1+e)(v.n)n forward; BANK SHOT = mirror target T'=T-(1+1/e)d n across a Surface, feed T' to the EXISTING firing solution. Exact for walls whose normal is perpendicular to gravity; floor deferred (surface_bankable gates |ny|~0 AND e>0). Perceived wall (Region of Loci) -> Surface via region_plane_x/region_x_spread.

microtheory.name: ballistics
microtheory.description: What moves where: the projectile flies x(t)=x0+v cos th t, y(t)=y0+v sin th t - 1/2 g t^2. To HIT a known target I do not simulate forward - I invert: the angle making the arc pass through (x,y) is Atan2(v^2 +/- sqrt(v^4 - g(g x^2 + 2 y v^2)), g x). Two arcs reach a reachable target; they coincide at max range (D=0) and vanish beyond it (D<0). Verify by forward substitution: y_pred = x tan th - g x^2/(2 v^2 cos^2 th) must equal y.

concepts.name: rel_x
concepts.comment: horizontal distance launcher->target (x = tx - x0). x=launcher, y=target.

concepts.name: rel_y
concepts.comment: vertical offset of the target (y = ty - y0).

concepts.name: discriminant
concepts.comment: D = v^4 - g(g x^2 + 2 y v^2). D>=0 <=> reachable; two solutions when D>0, grazing at D==0, none when D<0.

concepts.name: reachable
concepts.comment: target in range <=> D >= 0.

concepts.name: firing_angle_low
concepts.comment: LOW/direct arc = Atan2(v^2 - sqrt(D), g x). MUST be gated on `reachable`: Sqrt returns 0 for D<0, so reading this unreachable emits a bogus angle.

concepts.name: firing_angle_high
concepts.comment: HIGH/lob arc = Atan2(v^2 + sqrt(D), g x). Same reachability gate.

concepts.name: impact_y_low
concepts.comment: FORWARD check of the low arc: y_pred = x tan th - g x^2/(2 v^2 cos^2 th), th=firing_angle_low. Correct iff y_pred ~= rel_y.

concepts.name: impact_y_high
concepts.comment: FORWARD check of the high arc (same formula, th=firing_angle_high).

concepts.name: hits_low
concepts.comment: low arc lands on target: |impact_y_low - rel_y| < 1e-2.

concepts.name: hits_high
concepts.comment: high arc lands on target: |impact_y_high - rel_y| < 1e-2.

concepts.name: tof_low
concepts.comment: time-of-flight along the low arc = x / (v cos th). Used to LEAD a moving target.

concepts.name: lead_tx
concepts.comment: FIRST-ORDER intercept x of a moving target (tvx,tvy): where it will be after tof_low. Aim a fresh solution at (lead_tx,lead_ty) and iterate to refine.

concepts.name: lead_ty
concepts.comment: first-order intercept y of a moving target (see lead_tx).

concepts.name: wind
concepts.comment: horizontal wind acceleration w off the Launcher. ABSENT -> 0.0, so a grenade Launcher with no wind attr reads w=0 and every wind-aware concept collapses to the original no-wind path. x=launcher. [coerced Plus(Attr,0): absent wind reads None which is inconsistent in arithmetic (Times(None,None)=1), so every Attr(wind) is wrapped Plus(...,0.0) -> absent reads 0.0 and the w==0 branch fires byte-identically]

concepts.name: g_eff
concepts.comment: |a| = Sqrt(w^2 + g^2), the effective-gravity magnitude in the tilted (down-aligned) frame. w=0 -> Sqrt(g^2)=g (but never used as a result at w=0; the IfThenElse guards select the original concepts then).

concepts.name: tilt_phi
concepts.comment: phi = Atan2(w, g): the angle by which a=(w,-g) tilts 'down' toward +x from vertical. R(-phi)*(w,-g) = (0,-g_eff). w=0 -> phi=0.

concepts.name: rel_x_t
concepts.comment: x' = rel_x*cos phi + rel_y*sin phi : target's horizontal coord in the down-aligned frame (R(-phi) applied). w=0 -> phi=0 -> x'=rel_x.

concepts.name: rel_y_t
concepts.comment: y' = rel_y*cos phi - rel_x*sin phi : target's vertical coord in the down-aligned frame. w=0 -> phi=0 -> y'=rel_y.

concepts.name: discriminant_tilted
concepts.comment: D' = v^4 - g_eff*(g_eff*x'^2 + 2*y'*v^2): the EXISTING discriminant, evaluated in the tilted frame (g->g_eff, rel_x->x', rel_y->y'). Reachability of the wind problem is Gte(D',0).

concepts.name: discriminant_w
concepts.comment: REGIME=DATA gate. w==0 -> the ORIGINAL discriminant byte-for-byte (grenade unchanged); w!=0 -> discriminant_tilted (gorillas). Drives reachable_w and firing_unreachable.

concepts.name: reachable_w
concepts.comment: target in range (wind-aware) <=> D_w >= 0. w=0 -> identical to `reachable`. Gates firing_solution; disjoint from firing_unreachable (Lt vs Gte on the same D_w).

concepts.name: firing_angle_low_w
concepts.comment: LOW/direct arc, wind-aware = Atan2(v^2 - sqrt(D'), g_eff*x') + phi : solve the tilted no-wind low arc, rotate launch angle back by +phi. w==0 -> the ORIGINAL firing_angle_low byte-for-byte. MUST be gated on reachable_w (Sqrt(D'<0)=0 emits a bogus angle).

concepts.name: firing_angle_high_w
concepts.comment: HIGH/lob arc, wind-aware = Atan2(v^2 + sqrt(D'), g_eff*x') + phi. w==0 -> the ORIGINAL firing_angle_high byte-for-byte. Same reachability gate.

concepts.name: tof_low_w
concepts.comment: time of flight = x' / (v*cos(th-phi)) : the tilted-horizontal tof, which equals the true flight time (rotation preserves time). th-phi = th' (tilted launch angle). w=0 -> rel_x/(v cos th) = original tof_low.

concepts.name: impact_x_low_w
concepts.comment: FORWARD x at impact WITH wind: x(t)=v cos th t + 0.5 w t^2, th=firing_angle_low_w, t=tof_low_w. Must equal rel_x. w=0 -> v cos th * (rel_x/(v cos th)) = rel_x trivially.

concepts.name: impact_y_low_w
concepts.comment: FORWARD y at impact WITH wind: y(t)=v sin th t - 0.5 g t^2. Must equal rel_y. w=0 -> collapses to the original x tan th - g x^2/(2 v^2 cos^2 th).

concepts.name: hits_low_w
concepts.comment: low arc lands on target (wind-aware): |impact_x_low_w-rel_x|<1e-2 AND |impact_y_low_w-rel_y|<1e-2. Witnesses correctness in BOTH regimes; reduces to the original hits_low at w=0.

concepts.name: tof_high_w
concepts.comment: high-arc flight time = x'/(v cos(th_high-phi)).

concepts.name: impact_x_high_w
concepts.comment: FORWARD x at impact, high arc, with wind term.

concepts.name: impact_y_high_w
concepts.comment: FORWARD y at impact, high arc, with wind term.

concepts.name: hits_high_w
concepts.comment: high arc lands on target (wind-aware).

concepts.name: locus_X
concepts.comment: world X off a Locus = the value of its role-0 Coord. Same role-selecting fold as projection's screen_u: Sum over `at`-coords, each gated by (its axis proj_role == 0). Exactly one role-0 coord contributes; others zero out. x=locus (call via Holds(locus_X, loc, loc)).

concepts.name: locus_Y
concepts.comment: world Y off a Locus = the value of its role-1 Coord (raycast_triangulate puts X on latax role0, Y on otheraxis role1). Mirror of locus_X.

concepts.name: v_dot_n
concepts.comment: v.n = vx*nx + vy*ny. x=incoming velocity (vx,vy), y=Surface (nx,ny). The scalar the reflection law projects out.

concepts.name: reflect_factor
concepts.comment: (1+e)(v.n). e wrapped Plus(Attr(e),0.0): absent restitution reads 0 (dead stop). x=velocity, y=Surface.

concepts.name: reflect_vx
concepts.comment: v'_x = vx - (1+e)(v.n) nx. THE bounce primitive (x-component). e=1 flips the normal component, e=0 kills it; tangential preserved. x=velocity, y=Surface.

concepts.name: reflect_vy
concepts.comment: v'_y = vy - (1+e)(v.n) ny. The bounce primitive (y-component). x=velocity, y=Surface.

concepts.name: bank_perp_d
concepts.comment: signed perpendicular distance target->plane: d = (T-P).n. x=Target, y=Surface.

concepts.name: bank_scale
concepts.comment: restitution mirror scale = 1 + 1/e. e=1 -> 2 (standard mirror T'=T-2 d n); e<1 stretches the return leg. e=0 -> div-by-zero (gated out by surface_bankable). EXACT when n perp gravity. x=Surface (call Holds(bank_scale,surf,surf)).

concepts.name: surface_bankable
concepts.comment: bankable iff normal perpendicular to gravity (|ny|~0, gravity is +y) AND e>0. n perp g => the mirror unfolding is EXACT. Gravity-aligned surfaces (floor, |ny|~1) DEFERRED. x=Surface.

concepts.name: mirror_tx
concepts.comment: mirror target X: tx' = tx - (1+1/e) d nx. Feed (tx',ty') into the EXISTING firing solution -> bank angle. Vertical wall n=(+/-1,0),e=1: tx'=2xw-tx. x=Target, y=Surface.

concepts.name: mirror_ty
concepts.comment: mirror target Y: ty' = ty - (1+1/e) d ny. Vertical wall (ny=0): ty'=ty. x=Target, y=Surface.

concepts.name: region_plane_x
concepts.comment: plane X of a wall Region = the shared world-X of its comprised Loci (Min==Max==plane for a vertical wall). Reuses locus_X. x=Region.

concepts.name: region_plane_y
concepts.comment: a point on the wall line = min world-Y of its Loci. x=Region.

concepts.name: region_x_spread
concepts.comment: X-spread of a Region's Loci. ~0 <=> vertical wall (axis-aligned, normal +x) -> bankable Surface. The honest perceptual test. x=Region.

rules.name: firing_solution
rules.comment: Launcher aimed at Target, REACHABLE (D>=0): mint FiringSolution with both arc angles (arc_low=direct, arc_high=lob) + discriminant, edged launcher -has_solution-> sol. sid=lid*1e6+tid dedups one solution per (launcher,target). Disjoint from firing_unreachable (Gte vs Lt on the same D). Self-terminating + fixpoint-idempotent.

rules.name: firing_unreachable
rules.comment: Target out of range (D<0): mint the FiringSolution but mark reachable=0 and emit NO angle (Sqrt(D)=0 there would feed a bogus Atan2). Disjoint from firing_solution via Lt(D,0). Idempotent.

rules.name: target_from_locus
rules.comment: PERCEPTION->BALLISTICS JOIN. A Launcher -aims_at_locus-> Locus aims at a triangulated world point: read X off the Locus's role-0 Coord (locus_X) and Y off its role-1 Coord (locus_Y) -- the SAME role-fold projection's screen_u/screen_v use -- and mint/refresh a Target(tx=X,ty=Y) edged launcher -aims_at-> tgt. firing_solution then fires UNCHANGED on that Target, so (tx,ty) flows raycast_triangulate -> Locus.Coords -> Target -> rel_x/rel_y -> firing_angle_*_w with NO hand-glue. tid = lid_launcher*1e6 + loc.lid dedups one Target per (launcher,locus); add_node_if_absent/add_edge dedup and set_attr is a no-op at fixpoint -> idempotent + self-terminating. GUARD Gte(Count(at),2): fire only on a Locus that actually carries >=2 coords (a recovered world point), never a bare node. SELF-SUBSETTING: ballistics keeps depends_on []; this rule lies dormant until something mints a Locus + aims_at_locus (the FPS regime, where projection is co-loaded). A gorillas-only agent never mints them and aims via a directly-given Target.

rules.name: surface_from_region
rules.comment: PERCEPTION->BALLISTICS: a Region flagged is_wall whose Loci share an X (region_x_spread~0) is a VERTICAL WALL -> mint a Surface{px=region_plane_x, py=region_plane_y, nx=1, ny=0, e}. sfid=region.rid dedups one Surface per wall. e defaults to 1 (perfect bounce) when the region carries no restitution (absent reads 0 -> IfThenElse lifts to 1.0; a perceived wall's restitution isn't visually observable, so the rigid-wall prior is e=1). Dormant until a Region with comprises-Loci exists (FPS regime, projection co-loaded) -> ballistics keeps depends_on []. Idempotent + self-terminating.

rules.name: bank_mirror_target
rules.comment: BANK SHOT (inverse), step 1: Launcher banks_off a BANKABLE Surface and aims_at a real Target -> mint the MIRROR Target T' = T-(1+1/e)d n (mirror_tx/mirror_ty), aim launcher -aims_at-> T'. The EXISTING firing_solution then fires on T' UNCHANGED, producing the bank angle + its forward witness (hits_*_w on T'). tid'=-(sfid*1e6+tid) (negative -> never collides with a real positive tid; one mirror per (surface,target), launcher-independent). Guard surface_bankable: normal perp gravity AND e>0. Excludes mirroring a mirror (is_mirror coerced). Idempotent + self-terminating.

rules.name: bank_solution
rules.comment: BANK SHOT, step 2 (reachable): the mirror Target T' is in range -> mint a first-class BankSolution edged launcher -has_bank_solution-> bs, reading the bank angle straight off the EXISTING wind-aware firing-angle concepts at T' (angle_bank_low/high = firing_angle_*_w(launcher,mtgt)). Forward witness = hits_*_w at T' (the unfolded direct shot reaches T' <=> the real bounced shot reaches T, since n perp gravity makes the vertical dynamics identical). bs at_target the REAL target (via mtgt mirror_of rtgt). bsid=lid*1e6+tid' dedups. Disjoint from bank_unreachable (reachable_w vs its negation). Idempotent.

rules.name: bank_unreachable
rules.comment: BANK SHOT, step 2 (out of range): the mirror Target is unreachable (D_w<0 at T') -> mint the BankSolution with reachable=0 and NO angle (Sqrt(D'<0)=0 would feed a bogus Atan2). Disjoint from bank_solution via Lt(D_w,0) vs reachable_w. Idempotent.
